inputs.text: Harry Wait was found guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge after requesting ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their consent. He was acquitted of another identity theft count, but the convictions are serious enough to show that election rules must be enforced—not waved away as “exposing vulnerabilities.” Secure elections are essential to public confidence and orderly self-government. That does not mean making it harder for lawful voters to cast a ballot; it means holding people accountable when they cross the line.
